records.title: 10-Q
records.text: During the three months ended March 31, 2022, indirect sales through our distributor channels increased to represent about 13% of our total sales, compared to 5% in the same period of 2021.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our backlog was approximately $210 million and $154 million at March 31, 2022 and December 31, 2021, respectively, primarily driven by strong order growth during the year and longer lead times for certain components.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: ◦Deferred revenue, current decreased by $3 million primarily related changes in foreign currency exchange rates and recognition of point-in-time deferrals during the first quarter of 2022, partially offset by additional software-related deferrals.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The impact of recent pricing changes also increased our total revenue by approximately 4% compared to the same period in 2021.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the three months ended March 31, 2022 and 2021, operating income was $31 million and $10 million, respectively, an increase of 220%.
